Home.headline: Learn Chinese with Mazen
Home.lede: Short video lessons explained in Arabic, one level after another, from your first tone to real conversation. Start with a free lesson today.
Home.pathBody: Watch the lesson, pass its short quiz, and the next one opens. Every finished lesson gets Mazen's seal, so you always know where you are.
Home.pathExample: Example of a level in progress
Home.step1Body: Pay once by card in Egyptian pounds. The level is yours for life.
Home.step2Body: Each lesson is a short video with Mazen, then a quiz to check yourself.
Home.step3Body: Pass the quiz and the next lesson opens. Your progress is saved on every device.
Home.aboutBody: Mazen's introduction will appear here: who he is, how he learned Chinese, and how he teaches it to Arabic speakers.
Home.aboutPending: Text to be written by Mazen
Home.closeBody: No payment needed to try. Create an account and start with the four tones.
Home.footer: Chinese lessons for Arabic speakers, taught by Mazen.
